row.category: Vertical SaaS (Healthcare, Education, Real Estate, Construction, Field Service)
row.evidence: Netsmart sells myAvatar, its behavioral health EHR, through 'Request a demo'; ntst.com publishes no pricing, SSO protocol, SCIM or user-provisioning documentation for it.
row.notes: New row. Quote-only: no public pricing (demo request only). myAvatar is Netsmart's behavioral health and addictions EHR (part of the CareFabric platform). Netsmart's human-services page mentions 'single sign-on' generically and Plexus Cloud hosting mentions an identity and access management platform, but no page names SAML/OIDC, IdPs, SCIM or provisioning. Product documentation is client-only. Okta has no Netsmart or myAvatar app and Entra has no tutorial. Status unknown rather than none because admin docs are not public.

scim.notes: No SCIM or user-provisioning documentation on ntst.com; myAvatar product documentation is not public.

okta.notes: OIN searches for 'myavatar' and 'netsmart' return no results.

entra.notes: No myAvatar or Netsmart entry in the Entra SaaS app tutorial index (toc.json).

fallbacks.notes: Netsmart marketing says its EHRs offer 'single sign-on' and Plexus Cloud hosting includes an 'Enterprise-level identity and access management platform', but neither names the protocol, the IdPs or user provisioning, and myAvatar admin documentation is not public.
